Masdar's WISER Pioneers Program identifies and supports emerging leaders in renewable energy and sustainability through cohort-based engagements in Abu Dhabi. Each cohort call, including eligibility, benefits and the closing date, is announced on Masdar's strategic-initiatives page.

Programme Highlights

  • Masdar-backed platform connecting young professionals to the UAE clean-energy ecosystem
  • Cohort structure with mentorship and project engagement
  • Call-specific deadlines announced per cohort
  • Gateway to Abu Dhabi's renewable-energy and climate-tech networks

Who Should Apply

Early- and mid-career professionals and researchers in renewable energy, sustainability and climate fields, per each cohort's eligibility note.

Funding and Costs

Programme support per the current call, as described on the official WISER Pioneers page.

Deadline and How to Apply

Check the WISER Pioneers page for the live cohort call and follow the application instructions stated there. Key deadline information: Cohort-based call — the current round and its closing date are announced on the Masdar programme page.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About Masdar (UAE)

Masdar is Abu Dhabi's renewable-energy company and a global investor in clean technology. Its strategic initiatives include programmes that develop talent for the global energy transition.

Official website: https://masdar.ae

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Cohort-based call - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
